meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 OpenClaw 配置迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw configuration to NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are migrating from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2

howto.what: 当你要求从 OpenClaw 迁移时,Claude 会先扫描现有安装并总结配置,然后以对话方式逐项和你确认要迁移的内容,显示改动后再执行。迁移过程会记录在状态文件中,分阶段完成。
howto.when: 当你说出「migrate from openclaw」「openclaw migration」或「import from openclaw」时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw
迁移前先给我看 OpenClaw 里有哪些频道和定时任务
只迁移我的身份和群组,定时任务不要
say.note: 按你的决定调整迁移内容

howto.what_en: When you ask to migrate from OpenClaw, Claude scans the existing installation, summarizes its config, then discusses with you what to bring over and shows proposed changes before applying. It maintains a migration state file and proceeds through phases.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", or "import from openclaw".

say_en.text: Help me migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw
Show me the channels and scheduled tasks in OpenClaw first
Only migrate my identity and groups, skip scheduled tasks
